# BondoMod v0.2.11

- Correct the first verified local match loadout before forwarding it, instead of discovering it after the game has received the stock preset.
- Give initial recognition its own bounded processing budget. Retain local-player validation and ordered forwarding; packets without a verified match remain unchanged.
- Automatically send limited support reports for persistent match recognition failures, missing painted-item baselines and spawner runtime errors while signed in. Disable automatic reports in Settings.
- Queue reports offline, retry at most once per 15 minutes and group repeated errors for an hour.
- Include equipped cosmetic IDs by slot, parser progress, candidate counts and matching thresholds in support reports. Credentials, IP addresses, paths and packet contents are excluded.

Regression tests cover a reset on match entry and a reset after a goal. Resolution of the reported user cases still needs confirmation on the affected PC; unsupported loadout formats can still prevent recognition. Owned RLCS / Esports decals may still reset spawned item colours after a goal.
